sketch.name: NetPositionLadder
sketch.description: An ethanol position ladder: for each delivery month, physical purchases and sales against futures hedges, with the net open position highlighted and checked against the desk's limit.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit the volumes are in, shown after the totals.

props.name: view
props.description: Gross shows purchases, sales and futures per month; Net shows the net open position against the limit.

props.name: limit
props.description: The desk's net position limit per month (either way), in the unit; 0 for none.

props.name: showHedges
props.description: Shows the futures hedge bar in the gross view.

props.name: months
props.description: Delivery months, nearest first: { month, physicalLong (purchases), physicalShort (sales), futures (+ long / − short) }.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no designer-edited items): months are data rows. Net = purchases − sales + futures. Hedged % = |futures| / |physical net|. Every month shares one scale (gross: the largest leg; net: the largest net or 115% of the limit). Bars diverge from a centre zero line: short to the left, long to the right. Gross view: purchases (green) and sales (red) on top, futures (violet) below, a dark tick at the net. Net view: one bar per month coloured by sign, dashed ±limit lines; a net over the limit is underlined red and counted in Limit breaches. Colours from the GridKrafter palette (green, red, violet). Meant for a GridBoard card about 6 columns x 6 rows.
